queries: WITH c AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), s AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, telescope_count * 1.0 / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share FROM c) SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS diff_from_avg_share FROM s ORDER BY diff_from_avg_share DESC LIMIT 10

responses.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), s AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, telescope_count * 1.0 / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share FROM c) SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS diff_from_avg_share FROM s ORDER BY diff_from_avg_share DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The average share is the mean of the per-observatory shares across observatories that have at least one telescope (equals 1 / number of such observatories). Observatories with no telescopes are excluded because the request counts by observstation in the telescopes table.
Ties at the 10th position are broken arbitrarily by LIMIT 10.
